description: This source file defines the 'TransformationMisc' class, a snippet for demonstrating various graphics transformation techniques (rotation, scaling, skewing) using the PdfSharp library within a .NET environment. The class contains methods to render these transformations within drawing boxes, illustrating their effects on rectangles.
